promptEs: En Do mayor, ¿cómo se cifra el dominante secundario que resuelve en V?
promptEn: In C major, how is the secondary dominant that resolves to V labelled?
explanationEs: En Do mayor, el dominante de V es Re7 y se cifra V/V. Resuelve en Sol (V): su tercera es la sensible de Sol y sube un semitono.
explanationEn: In C major, the dominant of V is D7 and it is labelled V/V. It resolves to G (V): its third is the leading tone of G and rises a semitone.
